d: Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Chef de Partie, you’re not just overseeing the preparation of high-quality dishes – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Company Description: Awan Gas is one of the leading LPG companies in Oman, established in 1991 and headquartered in Aziba Capital One Building. The company has a strong presence across the Sultanate. Awan Gas focuses on providing easy, hassle-free bookings, multiple payment options, and quick home delivery services. With a growing customer base from all over Oman, the company is committed to safety, reliability, and customer satisfaction, offering a stable and service-oriented work environment for team members.

Role Description: To support the Logistics & Fleet Supervisor in coordinating daily LPG transportation and distribution operations, fleet activities, drivers, maintenance, and related administrative tasks, ensuring smooth, safe, and efficient operations.
q: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Mechanical Engineering, Maintenance Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
Previous experience in logistics, fleet, transportation, maintenance, or distribution is preferred.
Good communication skills in Arabic, English, and Hindi.
Problem-solving and ability to manage multiple tasks.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage.
Ability to use AI tools to automate tasks and improve processes.
r: Coordinate daily LPG deliveries, loading schedules, and vehicle allocation.
Communicate with drivers and follow up on deliveries and operational issues.
Follow up on vehicle maintenance, breakdowns, and spare parts.
Prepare reports and update operational records (Excel / ERP).
Implement AI tools and automation to improve operational efficiency
